description: Dynamic Power Software SDK and Simulator is provided by NVIDIA. NVIDIA's Dynamic Power Software SDK provides a Kubernetes-based simulator for evaluating DPS without physical data-centre equipment. Documented profiles emulate compute racks, power distribution, Redfish endpoints and the DPS API. Geographic context: global (software applicability). Temporal coverage and spatial resolution are not established beyond the source details stated here. The public source page provides documentation and links for obtaining the resource; no data or software archive was downloaded. Cost and access terms require confirmation with the provider. Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): NVIDIA Software License Agreement (proprietary). Emulation profiles represent selected hardware configurations; they do not establish thermal or electrical accuracy for arbitrary facilities. Potential simulation use: Prototype power-management integrations and controlled infrastructure scenarios. For catalogue navigation, platform-cloudsim offers related simulation context; this comparison does not assert an implemented connection.
